title: Field Report: Suspicious Individual Near Chemical Building East Door

fields.organization: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer — Security & Emergency Management
fields.inspector: HMI Operator Rios, Control Room Operator
fields.summary: At 09:58, a person in a gray hoodie and blue gloves was observed near the east door of the Chemical Building. The door was ajar, and interior light was visible. No response was received from the intercom or radio. Subsequent review of MBW-NVR-01 video footage for 09:58:33 shows the door was locked and the camera feed was unbroken. The PACS system logs show the door remained in 'locked' status throughout the window. The HMI indicates the door is closed and secure. The observer cannot confirm the presence of the individual on video or in system logs. The control system's integrity is now in question. The observer requests verification and a patrol to the site.

findings.notes: Shows 'closed' and 'locked', but video shows ajar at 09:58
Reports 'locked' at 09:58, but no user override logged
No video of individual; door closed at 09:58:33
No response from operator on DWS-1

actionsTaken: Verified PACS and HMI status for Door-03-E
Attempted contact via intercom and DWS-1 radio
Logged observation in Control Room log (CR-20261022-100212-0401)
recommendations: Dispatch Security Patrol to Chemical Building East Door (Door-03-E) for physical verification
Initiate PACS emergency override to manually unlock Door-03-E and confirm status
Preserve MBW-NVR-01 footage from 09:58:00 to 09:58:59 for forensic review
Report to Security & Emergency Manager per Section 7.6 (Physical Intrusion)
fields.photosNote: 1 photo attached: IMG_2026-0015-04 (HMI screen showing Door-03-E status: closed, locked)
fields.signature: HMI Operator Rios, Control Room Operator

instructorNote: This inject tests Security's ability to act on a conflicting system report. The player must recognize that the HMI and PACS are compromised and require physical verification. Watch for hesitation in issuing a patrol or failing to initiate the PACS override.
